en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing a group of soldiers in padded protective armor and face masks practicing bayonet or pole-weapon combat drills outdoors. Several pairs of trainees face each other with long rifles or poles, while officers in uniforms and caps observe. In the background, more soldiers stand in formation in front of low barracks buildings with tall leafy trees behind them.
